description: This file defines a Spring configuration class 'RetrieveLoanIdConfiguration' that sets up a bean for 'RetrieveLoanIdService'. It injects dependencies like 'LoanRepository' and 'NamedParameterJdbcTemplate' and provides a method to instantiate the service implementation if missing.
